case_name: Manish Verma vs Smt. Pooja Verma
facts_of_case: Marriage was solemnized on 04.05.2017. The parties could not go along and eventually started living separately since 02.01.2020. Husband filed an application for restitution of conjugal rights, which was dismissed by the trial court.
